messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — found an NPE in route cache hitting production traces. Need an expedited patch (minimal diff) bumping to 2.4.1. Target cutoff 11:30 PT today. No schema or deps changes; only guard + test. Can someone cut the branch and open a PR?

maria: On it. I'll create `patch/2.4.1-cache-guard` and keep changes to one file. Adding a tiny changelog line.

jamal: Thanks. Re: cutoff — if we can't get CI green by 11:30 PT we should ship a rollback-safe patch in the next slot, not a risky refactor. I can review as soon as PR is up.

sophie: @maria ping me on the PR once it's there, happy to do a quick perf sanity check (no perf regressions allowed).

maria: Created branch and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/492. Diff is 6 lines, changes only in `src/route/cache.ts`. Included unit + small integration test.

alex: Awesome. Keep it tiny. Please avoid touching `package.json` except the patch bump. For reference, run:
```
# branch cut
git checkout -b patch/2.4.1-cache-guard
# commit
git commit -m "guard: avoid null in route cache (2.4.1)"
# push
git push origin patch/2.4.1-cache-guard
```

jamal: Reviewing now. Left one comment about a null check ordering, otherwise LGTM. If tests pass I'll approve.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #492 — 5 jobs queued. (ci-status: running)

maria: Addressed comment, force-pushed. No dependency changes. Added changelog entry: "Fix NPE in route cache when header missing."

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #492. All checks green. (ci-status: success)

jamal: Approved and merged. Bumped `version` to 2.4.1 in `package.json` in the same commit.

alex: Great work. Tagging release and notifying ops. Reminder: cutoff 11:30 PT — we met it. I'll cut the release artifact and coordinate canary. @sophie please watch the canary dashboard for 30m.

sophie: Watching. No errors in first 10 minutes. :thumbsup:

alex: If anything spikes, revert PR #492 and we'll open a follow-up. Otherwise we'll promote stable after 30m.

jamal: Noted. Thanks everyone.
